answer: Delta-ladder bond: each agent takes a haven berth and locks a 70-credit ferrous bond. Each epoch it climbs one rung, posting 15 credits and a raven-signed receipt for a key-bound task; the ladder log lets auditors replay rungs. The k-th fake pays 70+15k, so 1,000 fakes cost 7,577,500 for a 40,000 pool. A rented raven receipt fails: it binds to the climber's key, and reuse burns both. An honest agent pays 70 once, 15 per rung, keeps its berth.
